symbols.name: scalar ring

symbols.name: pointwise network
symbols.meaning: The network acting on all the wire arrays together, applying every gate at each address.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathsf S_\Omega$ for the resulting network on all the wire arrays together.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible R-linear operator on arrays assigned to a source, gate or sink v.
symbols.quote: At each source, gate and sink $v$, assign an invertible $R$-linear operator $D_v$ on $R^\Omega$, called its frame.

symbols.name: input frame
symbols.meaning: The direct sum of the source frames over the input roles.
symbols.quote: It holds at the sources by definition: with $D_{\rm in}=\bigoplus_w D_{\mathrm{source}(w)}$ stacking the source frames over the input roles $w$, a physical input $f$ is interpreted as the logical input $g=D_{\rm in}^{-1}f$, which needs no preprocessing.

symbols.name: route sign
symbols.meaning: The scalar sign of the route from input role w.

symbols.name: gate fan-in
symbols.meaning: The number of input arrays of a gate.
symbols.quote: At a gate $G$ with $t$ input arrays, every incoming array has the common frame $D_v$, and a gate output combines the logical inputs $\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_t$ with coefficients $c_j\in R$.
